translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Nabz ne Devet kx yrbzle mz kxrmailz ngr dzbe kxnzngrng.

content.text: ?Kxnzetung, myx kxmule, nzaclve-krmu tubq,
X rsakrlrngr angidr?
Trtingr! Murde yrlqamu drtwr kx atrkatile leplz nemung,
Mz nzaetq-krbzmu drtqdr mz nrlc ka.
Nimu kxdrka'-ngrng. X ale-zvzamu da kxtrka,
Yzuo pnz mzli kc tzmcngr mzpu.
Apuamu ningidoe kcng tzrmakxng
Mz nzatrkati-krmu leplz.
X apu-kzamu kxnradrtqdr ngq murde pxtxpx-zvz-ngrnamu nzxlr-krmu nzyrni-krdr,
X nzayzlu-krbzmu natqdr.
Yawe, ayrplapx leplz lcng tzapulr ningidoe, mz nzyrvilz-krme nipna scdr.
X mz nzapu-krdr poi kz peto, taglctr-kzpz nqngidr.
Mrlzvxitx nzbatr-krbzme nzmyakr nipna scdr,
X nzmrbr-krdr na-apule lue kc tqmrbrlqo mz drtc'.
X mrlzvxi kz nzapu-krdr zwqwq r wagq kc tqlrprnebz mq mz nzngrla-krde x mz nibrde sc tqmrbrpe mou mz nztiokr nepi le.
X na-apu-kzlr itoto kx bz murde nzmika mzli kc tqpoobe-ngrde.
Gct, mzli kc tzlube-ngrdr, apusrngr nidr nabr kc tzikzti,
Mz nzodati-krm nidr mz zngya ngr drtwrm.
Zbz nigr kxnztubq nemqng sa na-abrtz-zlwz-ngrgr nznibqti-krm kxdrka'ngr lcng.
X sa naelalvzkr nzyrlekr mepyr ngrdr.
X sa napibzkr bam kx, “Gct, da zpwxtx! Sa nakabzme da kxmrlzting mz leplz kxnztubqng,
Murde nzaclve-krm lr nrlc tubq-esz'ngr.”
